en.body:
October 2026 is shaping up to be a brutal month for horror aficionados, with new scares designed to prey on everything from childhood fears to primal anxieties. Leading the charge is **Rob Savage**'s **Other Mommy**, a film that promises to go straight for the emotional jugular. Starring **Jessica Chastain**, this release, slated for October 9th, delves into the unsettling world of an eight-year-old girl named Bela. As her parents navigate marital strife, Bela finds herself confronting a sinister entity emerging from her closet, a presence she chillingly refers to as "Other Mommy." The film’s premise, as detailed by IMDb, suggests a deep dive into psychological horror, exploring how a child's perception can twist the mundane into the monstrous.

Beyond the confines of a single family's torment, the spectral echoes of a beloved horror icon are set to reverberate through the streaming landscape. The legendary **Carrie** White is making a comeback, appearing in a new series scheduled for an October 7th premiere. While specific plot details remain under wraps, the mere mention of **Carrie**'s return, following the tumultuous events of Stephen King's seminal novel and subsequent adaptations, is enough to send shivers down the spines of long-time fans. This revival, part of a slate of new horror series arriving in October, hints at exploring new facets of the telekinetic outcast's enduring legacy.

## Creatures of the Deep and Dark Secrets

Adding a different flavor of fright to the month, **Josh Hartnett** is diving into the abyss for the new series **Below**. Premiering on October 8th, this show plunges viewers into the murky waters of Widow's Bay, where **Hartnett** and his co-star **Charlie Heaton** will be hunting for elusive and terrifying sea monsters. The series promises to unravel dark secrets and strange disappearances, suggesting a blend of monster horror and mystery that is sure to captivate fans of oceanic dread and suspenseful storytelling.

## Why This October Haunts Us

The curated horror offerings for October 2026 represent a significant moment for genre fans. The return of **Carrie**, a character who has haunted our nightmares for decades, coupled with the deeply personal terror of **Other Mommy** and the high-stakes creature feature **Below**, showcases the breadth of horror storytelling being explored. It’s a testament to the genre's ability to adapt and evolve, offering both deeply psychological narratives and thrilling, visceral experiences. The focus on character-driven horror in **Other Mommy** alongside the creature-feature appeal of **Below** ensures that diverse fan bases will find something to sink their teeth into this Halloween season.

## What's Next

Mark your calendars: **Other Mommy** arrives October 9th, **Below** premieres October 8th, and the new **Carrie** series debuts October 7th. Prepare for a month of unparalleled scares.
